content.text:
`printDistances` is removed from `FloydWarshallService` and lives in a standalone `GraphPrinter` class. `GraphPrinter.print` takes a `Graph` interface directly — no coupling to the service or to `AdjacencyMatrixGraph` — so it works on any graph implementation and can be tested independently of the algorithm.

Each class now has exactly one reason to change: `FloydWarshallService` if the algorithm changes, `GraphPrinter` if the output format changes, `AdjacencyMatrixGraph` if the storage representation changes.
